jobs.program: Summer Clerkship Recruitment Program 2027 (clerkships commencing late 2027/early 2028)
jobs.notes: Scheme-wide dates for all participating NSW firms: applications open 9:00am AEST Wed 9 June 2027 and offers can be made from 9:00am Wed 8 September 2027; 'closes' is null because the Law Society publishes two closing dates (Sunday 4 July and Sunday 11 July 2027, at 11:59pm) and which applies depends on the individual firm, and eligibility is final or penultimate year students.

jobs.employer: The Law Society of New South Wales
jobs.notes: Scheme-wide market-offer dates for participating NSW firms and organisations: applications open Mon 22 February 2027, close 11:59pm AEST Sun 4 April 2027, interviews commence Tue 27 April 2027 and offers can be made from 9:00am Wed 2 June 2027.

Firm's own early careers page confirms applications open 9:00am AEST 9 June 2027 and close 11:59pm AEST 11 July 2027, with interviews in early August 2027, offers from 8 September 2027, and the clerkship running 29 November 2027 to 4 February 2028.

Firm's clerkship page states applications are currently closed and will open in June for the 2027/28 seasonal clerkship program, but no exact open or close date is published yet, so both fields are null.

Firm's graduate centre page confirms the 2026/2027 round has closed and that the 2027/2028 program will be advertised in line with the relevant Law Society/Law Institute guidelines, but no specific dates are published yet.

jobs.program: Seasonal Clerkship and Graduate Recruitment (2028 program cycle)
jobs.notes: QLS confirms the clerkship cycle commences with applications in July/August each year (2027-cycle offers were made 7 October 2026, so that round has closed) but the next cycle's application open/close dates are not yet published on the QLS page, so both fields are null.
